lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately six horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point, exhibiting a semi-regular grid topology.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity reflectance on the upper edge to low-intensity shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin, particularly along its leading edge.
